The store description says who runs the default relay and what a captcha loads. Every change is listed in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/knightloader/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

## ⚡ Improved

- **The store description names the default relay and the captcha widgets.** It says that the developer runs parleyport.halleluja.design, that the app follows a ParleyPort relay of your own when you scan the QR code, and that answering a captcha loads reCAPTCHA, hCaptcha or Cloudflare Turnstile in a web view.
